note: Offline experiments; served artifacts read-only. Seed-42 80/20 split; bootstrap 2000 resamples (percentile CIs).

calibration_ablation.note: ECE: equal-frequency (quantile) bins, 10 bins, |mean score - churn rate| weighted by bin share (as in train.py); equal-width-10 and quantile-15 shown as sensitivity. Threshold = F1-optimal on calibrated OOF train predictions (grid 0.020-0.950 step 0.005), the same rule that set the served placeholder.

feature_ablation_protocol: Fixed, untuned models: logistic regression (C=0.1, balanced) and XGBoost (250 trees, lr 0.03, depth 3, subsample 0.8, colsample 0.7); 5-fold stratified CV repeated twice (random_state 11) on the training set; mean CV AUC = average of the two models. Test effect: same fixed models refit on all of train, scored once on test.

profit_grid.label: HYPOTHETICAL values; sensitivity analysis only, not a business result
profit_grid.definition: per test customer (n=1409): mean over customers of contact * (y*s*v - c) (realised, uses observed churn) and contact * (p*s*v - c) (expected, uses calibrated p). Assumes the offer only affects would-be churners.

inner_loop.logreg: grid over C = logspace(-3, 1, 13), balanced class weights (13 candidates)
inner_loop.final_fit: 5-fold stratified search (random_state 42) on all of train
